name: python_org_jobs-mcp
description: Python.org Job Board (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Python.org Job Board RSS 2.0 feed (latest 20 approved jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Items carry no pubDate (posted_at is null); description begins with the location line followed by the HTML job description. title is '<Role>, <Company>'. id is the job page link.
